descriptions.zh: 在[fromfrom.planet.GetName]的冰冷荒原上，我们发现了一个小型预制庇护所，里面配备了休眠的生命维持系统和生活区。它们经过数千年的冰暴，严重风化，部分被掩埋。
descriptions.en: On the frigid wastelands of [fromfrom.planet.GetName], we have detected a small prefabricated shelter equipped with dormant life support devices and living quarters. They are heavily weathered and partially buried after millennia of ice storms.
